title: [BUG] search --semantic がembed済みでも「No embeddings found」エラー
root_cause: search --semantic reads from symbols.db (SymbolStore) but embed writes to embeddings.db (EmbeddingStore)
fix_approach: Change search to read from embeddings.db (EmbeddingStore) instead of symbols.db (SymbolStore)
tasks: Task 1.1: Add EmbeddingSimilarityResult, InvalidEmbedding error, blob_to_embedding(), cosine_similarity(), search_similar() to src/embedding/store.rs
Task 1.2: Add unit tests for search_similar in src/embedding/store.rs
Task 2.1: Add SearchError::EmbeddingStore variant with Display/source/From impls in src/cli/search.rs
Task 2.2: Change run_semantic_search() to use EmbeddingStore (Path::exists check, open, count, search_similar)
Task 2.3: Change try_hybrid_search() to use EmbeddingStore with graceful BM25 fallback
Task 2.4: Change suggest.rs maybe_add_semantic_step() to use EmbeddingStore
Task 3.1: Update tests/e2e_semantic_hybrid.rs to use EmbeddingStore
